Facts: /workspace/drafts/facts/lion-bornas.md (LB1 to LB43).
titles: Your Life as a Lion: 8 Things You Have to Get Through
_titles_note: Title confirmed by Social Studio 2026-11-15: 'Your Life as a Lion: 8 Things You Have to Get Through', the same pattern as the polar post. Single title, no A/B set.

lines.say: You were just born a lion. Here are eight things you have to get through.

lines.source_tag: San Diego Zoo; San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance fact sheet
lines.vis: Cub next to a lioness's paw for scale; 3 LB card pops / Pull back fast: the lioness alone in a thicket, the pride far off

shots.vis: Cub next to a lioness's paw for scale; 3 LB card pops

shots.vis: Push in on the spotted coat; spots dissolve as the cub morphs older

lines.say: Up to 80 percent of lion cubs die before they turn two.

lines.say: Your mother carried you for about three and a half months. She usually has one to four cubs, and keeps you away from the pride until you're six to eight weeks old.

lines.say: Meet the guy in the cardboard mane. That's Meatball. He's living all eight at home, with a rubber stamp.

shots.vis: Sauce on the couch, unimpressed (name tag pops)
Noodle in the doorway, wagging (name tag pops)

lines.say: Number three. The takeover.
lines.vis: Voiced number card

shots.vis: Voiced number card

description:
What is life like for a lion? This is your whole life as one, from about three pounds and hidden away to holding a pride: 8 things you have to get through, then the verdict. Meatball tried all eight at home, with his cat, Sauce, as his pride and his dog, Noodle, as everybody else.

Checked facts in this video:
- Up to 80% of lion cubs die within their first 2 years (Smithsonian's National Zoo); on average 60% die in the first year (San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance).
- Males entering a new pride will kill all cubs that cannot run from them (Smithsonian's National Zoo).
- Hunting success depends on the place: 38% Kalahari (Eloff 1984), 23% Serengeti (Schaller 1972), 15% Etosha (Stander 1992), via the SDZWA fact sheet.
- Females may lose up to 20% of kills to spotted hyenas (SDZWA, citing Cooper 1991).
- In Tanzania, a mid-2000s count found lions had killed more than 563 people since 1990, and injured at least 308 (Packer et al. 2005, Nature, PubMed 16107828).
- IUCN Red List: Vulnerable, 23,000 mature individuals, decreasing (assessed 2023).
- Visiting Kruger? SANParks rules say to remain in your vehicle unless in a designated area.

Sources:
- Smithsonian's National Zoo & Conservation Biology Institute, Lion: https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/lion
- San Diego Zoo Animals & Plants, Lion: https://animals.sandiegozoo.org/animals/lion
- San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance Library, Lion (Panthera leo) Fact Sheet: https://ielc.libguides.com/sdzg/factsheets/lions (citing Schaller 1972, Eloff 1984, Cooper 1991, Stander 1992, Funston et al. 2003, West and Packer 2013 and others)
- Panthera, Lion: https://panthera.org/cat/lion
- IUCN Red List, Panthera leo, Vulnerable A2abcd, assessed 1 Feb 2023 (published 2024)
- Packer C, Ikanda D, Kissui B, Kushnir H (2005) Lion attacks on humans in Tanzania. Nature 436:927-928. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16107828/
- Bauer H et al. (2015) Lion (Panthera leo) populations are declining rapidly across Africa, except in intensively managed areas. PNAS 112(48):14894-14899
- Stander PE (1992) Cooperative hunting in lions: the role of the individual. Behavioral Ecology and Sociobiology 29:445-454
- SANParks, Kruger National Park, Vital Information (rules): https://www.sanparks.org/parks/kruger/useful-information/vital-information
